title: Safaera Sáfica III: Perreo Paranormal
excerpt: 🕯️ YOUR FAVORITE GROWN & SAPPHIC PERREO IS BACK FROM THE DEAD. 🕯️
content:
🕯️ YOUR FAVORITE GROWN & SAPPHIC PERREO IS BACK FROM THE DEAD. 🕯️

Just because we’re grown and well-seasoned doesn’t mean we don’t want a good night out to shake ass too.

This Halloween, Safaera Sáfica returns for round III with PERREO PARANORMAL — the Bronx’s (and, as far as we’re concerned, THE CITY’S 👀) only 30+ lesbian-centered perreo.

And we’re doing Halloween on FRIDAY NIGHT for a reason. Come get spooky, sweaty, and sapphic with us Friday, then our parents, aunties, tíes, and folks with little ones can spend Saturday trick-or-treating with the family. We love a responsible grown-up schedule. 😂

👻 WHAT’S HAUNTING THE FUNCTION?

🎧 DJ NEMO on the decks, bringing you the millennial classics we grew up shaking ass to + the new-school perreo we love now.

🌈 Glow bracelet cruising system so you can set the vibe without saying a word:
💚 Open to flirting, lovers & meeting somebody
💛 Friends, conversation & dances
❤️ I’m here with my girls — respectfully, leave me alone!

💃🏽 Masc + femme go-go performances — and PLEASE bring your singles to tip your dancers!

🔮 Tarot readers
🍹 Halloween + sapphic-themed cocktails
🎃 Costume contest
💄 Last-minute costume props + makeup
👯 New-friend-making icebreakers
🎲 Ridiculous grown sapphic party games — including Bobbing for Coochie
🍬 Tricks + treats 🌿 420-friendly outdoor smoking + a 420 vendor if you need to do a little extra trick-or-treating at the venue

🌑 Dark lights, loud music, sweaty bodies, and six hours of sapphic Halloween foolishness.

🧛🏽‍♀️ COSTUMES
Encouraged, NOT required.
